newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho says no change in JCI talks.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho says no change in JCI talks.

text.p: Mining conglomerate Lonrho Plc said on Friday there has been no change in the status of its preliminary merger talks with South Africa's JCI Ltd.
The Financial Times on Friday reported that the prospects for such a merger were fading and that Lonrho would concentrate on its much-publicised restructuring.

"The only statement we have ever made on (the JCI merger possibility) was that we had received a preliminary approach. All the rest has been speculation. The status remains very much the same," a Lonrho spokesman said.
The London market, where Lonrho shares are traded, shrugged off the report. At 0819 GMT, Lonrho shares were up half a pence at 133 1/2 pence a share.

The spokesman said Lonrho had never said such a linkup, which would create a mining powerhouse with a market capitalisation of over three billion dollars, was likely. Both companies confirmed the preliminary discussions last month.
